patient_target_reuse.rule: the frozen target_audit NPZ/JSON are reused byte for byte
patient_target_reuse.reason: the patient targets must be identical to the ones the canary consumed; a rebuild would silently move the KMeans fit, the block split and the held-out margins

observation.boundary: The canonical layout is a target-blind contact-order readout, not patient anatomy. The six subjects without usable 3-D coordinates stay in the primary denominator.

null.applies_to: model readout contacts, so shaft membership survives and within-shaft contact identity is destroyed

candidate_library.source: rev11 NLC joint selection winner, used as shared pretrained morphology
candidate_library.frozen_independently_of_canary_alignment: the canary shares five subjects with the formal cohort, so its patient-alignment scores may not prune this library; the canary only clears capacity, detector behaviour and memory

stage_b.candidates: union of each subject's best two candidates from stage A

stage_c.candidates: union of each subject's single selected candidate

selection_protocol.why_staged: a flat 24-candidate by 4-seed sweep costs about three extra hours of wall clock at the five-worker cap for no extra selection information; the stages are frozen here before any formal score exists

search.readout_note: the batched contact readout blocks BLAS by chunk, which moves the envelope at float64 round-off, so the chunk size is frozen here and recorded in worker provenance

subject_primary.rule: observed strictly below the matched null median
subject_primary.why_not_a_per_subject_p_value: three subjects have too few distinct within-shaft permutations to ever reach p<=0.05, so a per-subject p gate would fail them for montage reasons rather than model reasons

same_network_k2.note: the natural clustering is unsupervised and is not compared against the permutation null; running the clustering inside every null draw would cost more than the simulation it scores, and the spec's requirement is a positive patient-template margin for both aligned clusters

sensitivity.rule: the paired canonical and real-geometry cohort effects must agree in direction

robustness.event_count_confound: report Spearman(subject null-relative delta, in-distribution event count) and re-run the cohort test after dropping the top event-count quartile
robustness.single_network_confound: report the pass fraction per confirmation seed; no single seed may supply more than half of the passing subjects

claim_boundary: A positive result may state that patient-conditioned data-driven SNNs recovered cohort-level held-out contact-order stereotypy against matched within-shaft nulls. It may not be shortened to reproducing 34 patients, and it does not establish anatomical cores, clinical waveform identity, patient-blind generalization or seizure mechanism.
